title: Retain long launcher errors in private collision-free diagnostic files
outcome: Long error logging preserves terminal evidence with private uniquely named files and tolerates a log-write refusal.
acceptance: Long launcher diagnostics use collision-free exclusive files with mode0600 and a bounded explicit artifact locator, without sharing a stage log name
A diagnostic write failure cannot prevent the terminal result from being saved; observable tests cover collision and failure handling
Development documentation accurately names the diagnostic artifact behavior
